lines.text: VALDORSO COATINGS S.p.A.
Via delle Fornaci 7 · Borgo Valdorso (TO) · Production plant
Ref. DR-1995-031 14 November 1995
DEVIATION REPORT DR-1995-031
Product: AF-12 anti-rust enamel (lead chromate). Lots: 5512 to 5519 (8
batches).
Detected by: returns from two customers; inspection of tins in
finished goods warehouse.
Description: tins opened after 4 to 6 weeks of storage show the enamel
thickened into a rubbery gel ("livering"). The gel cannot be stirred
back. The same lots were normal at filling.
Immediate action: lots 5512-5519 blocked. 3,400 kg returned and sent
for disposal.
Suspected cause: reaction between the acid groups of the alkyd and
the basic lead chromate pigment. Pigment lots CL-77/95-09 and
CL-77/95-10 from Cromopigmenti Lazzeretti were received in
September 1995 and used in all affected lots. Laboratory to test
pigment alkalinity.
Opened by: E. Marchisio, QC Laboratory.
Signature: E. Marchisio
